Rebuilt sequential vertex-toggle discrete Morse matching on the entire face poset: 5,432 disjoint Hasse pairs, exactly one critical vertex and four critical 7-simplices. Oriented all 63,780 covers and independently topologically sorted all 10,869 faces without a cycle. Discrete Morse gives a CW complex with one 0-cell and four 7-cells, necessarily wedge^4 S^7. This is an exhaustive FINITE graph check, not a family theorem.
